page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at the top, centred, in Greek capitals, with the printed page number 75 at the top right. Catchword "quen-" at the bottom right, below the last line. Signature "E 2" at the foot. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: corruptelâ, oppressæ, in vim suam pristinam & vigorem restituerentur; vel ut pravæ non- nullæ præter Legem consuetudines & Personales Abusus tollerentur; vel, quod Ipse forsan aut alii detrimentum Publico tulissent, resarcire- tur; vel, ut æque mihi hujusmodi conditiones deferrentur, propter quas, (cùm illis cordi esse intelligerem Coronæ Meæ Privilegia) multo facilius inducerer ad iis Rogationibus acquiescendum, quæ ita populi Bonum spe- ctabant, ut me non admodum minuerent, quem Lex, Natura, Ratio, & Religio primo loco jubent servare; sine quo, impossibile est Po- pulum meum (prout Muneri meo par est) conservare.

Illud saltem sperabam, in iis quæ prave ad- missa fuerant vel in Ecclesiastica Re vel Civi- li, tam moderata futura Reformandi studia, ut Fundamentum & Essentia utriusque Regiminis integra & salva manerent; haud vero ita utrumque conquassandum simul, & convellendum, nullâ prorsus ratione habitâ vel Legum jam obtinentium, vel Pietatis & Prudentiæ superiorum omnium Conventuum, vel Antiquæ & universæ Praxeos Christianæ Ecclesiæ, vel quæ ad Jura spectant & Privilegia Singularium: cum interim loco Illius, quod abolendum erat, nil omnino reponendum curarent, quod vel prioris Instituti bonum Finem attingeret, vel Defectus prætensos supplerct, vel Abusus reformaret, vel, Cordatis hominibus satisfaceret, qui non verbis Phaleratis & mollibus, zelum quen-

page.notes: Long s is transcribed as plain s throughout. Italic type is marked where the printed words are set in italic; the italic status of "Re vel" and of some words in the second paragraph is uncertain. "fuerant" is printed with a form that may be f or long s; it is given as f. "Legū" is read from a tilde over the u. No running head is printed on the left page; the Greek running head is read from the right side of the page top. The left edge shows only show-through and the neighbouring page edge, which are left out.
